title: Infant baptism rightly practiced
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): 5. Infants stand as rightly baptized in ye New Testament as boys stood as circumcised in ye Old—because ye same promise and covenant, ye same Christ, and ye same faith belonging toward covenanted parents. — 4. Infants belonging toward both believing and unbelieving parents stand as toward be baptized—not because belonging toward fleshly generation or parents' merits, but because belonging toward ye promise belonging toward grace adhering toward ye covenant (Gen. 17; Acts 2:39; 1 Cor. 7:14).
pass_b_english: 4. Infants of both believing and unbelieving parents are to be baptized—not because of fleshly generation or parents' merits, but because of the promise of grace adhering to the covenant (Gen. 17; Acts 2:39; 1 Cor. 7:14).
5. Infants are rightly baptized in the New Testament as boys were circumcised in the Old—because the same promise and covenant, the same Christ, and the same faith of covenanted parents.
source_text: 4. Infantes parentum tam fidelium quam infidelium baptizandi sunt, non ob carnis generationem aut merita parentum, sed ob promissionem gratiae foederi adhaerentem (Gen. 17; Acts 2:39; 1 Cor. 7:14). 5. Infantes recte baptizantur in novo testamento, sicut pueri circumciduntur in veteri—quia eadem promissio & foedus, idem Christus, eadem fides parentum foederatorum.
